assets.desc: a tall white-enamel hospital procedure cabinet with glass doors (contents hidden by frosted glass) on a steel frame, with a big red cross on the top panel — medicine. Realistic Soviet 1980s object, worn and dusty, real-life paint/material colours, muted desaturated palette, LARGE massive readable silhouette, ONE clear stencilled icon or label hinting at the contents. Volume like Project Zomboid sprites: light from the top-left, shaded right side, dark contact shadow at the base. Closed.
